entries.title: Commissioner of Investigations and Enforcement v Kanyago (Income Tax Appeal E069 of 2025)
entries.principle: Tax appeals are determined on the evidence; the Commissioner must prove the assessment and the taxpayer may challenge it on the facts and the law.

entries.title: Highway Furniture Mart Limited v Commissioner of Value Added Tax & Another
entries.principle: VAT assessments must be based on the correct application of the Act; the taxpayer bears the burden of proving that an assessment is excessive.

entries.title: Nakumatt Holdings Limited v Commissioner of Value Added Tax
entries.principle: VAT assessments must comply with the Value Added Tax Act; the taxpayer may challenge the assessment on the facts and the law.

entries.title: Commissioner of Income Tax v Westmont Power (K) Ltd (Income Tax Appeal 626 of 2002)
entries.principle: Tax assessments must be based on the correct application of the Income Tax Act; the taxpayer bears the burden of proving that an assessment is excessive.
